AlternateSet.description: Switches and the garments that cause them.

id.description: Stable for as long as the set exists.

name.description: A name for people; the game never sees it.

sources.description: What changes them while it is worn.

anyOf.description: A garment of the pack, by its stable id.
An asset of another collection, as the file states it.

Asset.description: A drawable or prop: a garment of the pack, or one the pack does not hold.

Carried.description: A file the manifest registers with the shop and that is carried unchanged.

directive.description: The manifest line that registered it: its directive (`data_file`, or a server's own) and its type (`SHOP_PED_APPAREL_SPAK_FILE`).

file.description: The file, as a path inside the module's folder.

Dummies.description: What a pack does with a dummy, a garment that holds a place and ships no model.

leave_on_delete.description: A garment taken out of a slot leaves a dummy at its place, so the garments after it keep theirs.

replace_on_add.description: A garment added to a slot takes the place of the first dummy there, and the dummy goes.

Expression.description: An entry of the creature metadata a garment adds: the tracks that drive an expression of its drawable.

Garment.description: One drawable of a slot, or a place held for one.

alternates.description: The drawables the game shows in place of the model, `<model>_1.ydd` and on, which `numAlternatives` counts.

cloth.description: The `.yld`, as a path inside the module's folder: the cloth the game simulates for a component's drawable, shipped under the model's own name. A garment has cloth when one is linked, and `ownsCloth` is written from that.

expressions.description: The entries it adds to the creature metadata of the pack, such as the expression of a heel.

group.description: The one named set a person keeps it in, beside its ped and slot; the game never sees it.

id.description: Stable for as long as the garment exists and never reused: a rename, a renumbering or an edit keeps it.

label.description: A name for people; the game never sees it.

missing_cloth.description: An import found the metadata stating `ownsCloth` and no cloth file for it. Never set by hand: linking a cloth or unlinking clears it, and while it stands the garment is missing its cloth.

model.description: The `.ydd`, as a path inside the module's folder with `/`; none for a place held, which the game sees as a drawable with no model.

ped.description: The ped it dresses, none while nobody has said.

position.description: Where it sits among the drawables of its slot, when somebody decided; it takes the lowest free place otherwise.

tags.description: Words a person files the garment under, for finding it again; the game never sees them.

wind_scale.description: The wind scale the build writes into every cloth of the linked `.yld`, in place of the one the file states; none ships the file as it is ([`crate::wind`]).

Level.description: How serious a finding is, as `wardrobe.json` spells it.

Meta.description: What the engine's metadata states of a garment beyond its textures, under the engine's names; a value left out is the one the engine writes for a new record.

dlc.description: The collection it is in, none for the game's own.

Ped.description: A freemode ped, by the model name the game knows it by

Replace.description: What one ped's files of a pack replace of the game.

dlc.description: The collection of the game the files replace, as the game names it (`male_freemode_beach`); none for the drawables of the ped itself.

SavedQuery.description: A query a pack keeps under a name: its text, read again each time it is asked.

Setting.description: What a project says of one rule; a word left out is the rule's own.

on.description: `false` switches the rule off, so it finds nothing.

threshold.description: Where the rule's limit stands, in the unit the rule lists it in.

dummies.description: What the pack does with the places its dummies hold.

freeze.description: Whether a build that goes through freezes the drawables it shipped in `wardrobe.lock.json`; it does unless this says no.

replace.description: The peds whose files replace the game's own instead of adding a collection: a DLC collection of the game, or the ped itself. Such files are written with no metadata, and a build says so, and that nobody has seen the game load them.

settings.description: What the project changed, by the code of the rule.

target.description: The edition the pack is built for, where it is built for one: a limit that depends on it holds only for that edition. Both when it says none.

Shop.description: How the pack's shop metadata is written, and what an import kept of a shop's own.

carried.description: Files a resource's manifest registers with the shop that this engine does not read, carried unchanged.

durty_hashes.description: Name each entry that states no id as Durty Cloth Tool names it (`CLO_DCT_TOP_0_0_M`), so a script, a shop table or a package keyed on its names still finds the entries after a move to OpenRage; off, an entry is named for its collection, slot, position and texture.

unplaced.description: Entries an import read that point at no garment, kept as they were stated and written back with the rest.

ShopEntry.description: What a shop's metadata states of one entry, kept as written.

cost.description: The `value` of its `cost`, as written; the plan writes 0 where none is stated.

entry.description: Which entry of that file it was, counting from 0 through the components and then the props.

fields.description: Every other element the entry states (`forcedComponents`, `restrictionTags`), as XML in the order stated.

from.description: The file it was read from, as the import saw its path; empty for an entry made here.

id.description: `uniqueNameHash` exactly as the file wrote it: a name the game hashes, or a literal value, never read as a number because it need not fit 32 bits. Empty for an entry a person made by editing the price or the tags of a texture no file stated, which the build names.

Skin.description: u for a drawable that fits every skin tone, r for one with a texture for each

Slot.description: A slot a garment fills: a component by its file-name word, or a prop by its anchor

Stated.description: An entry of a shop file that points at no garment of the pack, with the place it points at.

prop.description: Whether it was in the props of the file; the components otherwise.

Switch.description: A drawable that wears alternate `alt` of its model while a set's garments are worn.

alt.description: The number after the model's name: `hair_000_u_1.ydd` is alternate 1.

Target.description: The game a pack is built for, which decides the limits that depend on it.

shop.description: The shop entry an import read for this texture: its id is the one a build writes.

shop_id.description: An id somebody chose for this texture's shop entry, which wins over the one an import read.

texture.description: The `.ytd`, as a path inside the module's folder; none for a texture held for a place with no file.

tint.description: The word a component texture's name ends with; `uni` or `whi` by the garment's skin where it states none.

Waiver.description: A rule the pack does not hold itself to, with the reason.

garment.description: The garment it concerns, by id; every garment where none.

description: A pack of clothing for the freemode peds.

alternates.description: The drawables that wear an alternate model while garments of the pack are worn ([`crate::alternate`]).

collections.description: The collection each ped's garments are in, as the game resolves it; `mp_m_<pack>` and `mp_f_<pack>` where a ped has none.

pack.description: The name of the pack: the folder of its streamed files, the stem of its collections and of its creature metadata.

queries.description: The queries the pack keeps by name, which the list offers as smart groups ([`crate::query`]).

rules.description: What the project changed of the rules the pack is held to: the edition it is built for, and for a rule that can change, whether it is on, how serious it is and where its limit stands.

shop.description: How the shop metadata is written; the default is OpenRage's.

title: Wardrobe
